summary: Implemented the revised (in-process) reliability design: fixed-window rate limiter on link creation with configurable limit, readiness probe checking SQLite connectivity, correlation-id middleware, uniform problem-details handling for exceptions and status codes. Existing endpoints and the click writer are unchanged.

files.reason: AddRateLimiter + policy, AddProblemDetails, UseExceptionHandler/UseStatusCodePages, CorrelationIdMiddleware, UseRateLimiter (ADR-8 revised, ADR-10).
RateLimitPolicies constant, RequireRateLimiting on POST, /health/ready readiness route (ADR-9).

risks: Per-instance limits only; documented as a known limitation.
Fixed window permits edge bursts up to 2x the limit across a boundary.
